name: phone-input
purpose: International phone-number control: an `InputGroup` with a searchable country `Select` on the left (the closed trigger shows the selected country's flag, its name and, at the end, its dial code, like a row of the list) and a `type="tel"` input on the right that applies the selected country's mask as the user types and accepts exactly the lengths that country allows. Two v-models (`v-model` for the national digits, `v-model:country` for the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code) carry the editable state; the one-way `phone-change` event hands the form the full E.164 number and whether it is complete. It carries no label or helper text: wrap it in a `Field` (`Field.Label` + `PhoneInput` + `Field.Description`), and it picks up `id`, `aria-describedby`, `invalid`, `disabled` and `required` from the Field.
useWhen: International phone entry where the user picks a country and types the national number with that country's mask.
Forms that need the full E.164 number and whether it is complete, without per-country length rules in the form.
avoidWhen: The value may include characters the masks reject (extensions, free-form notes) → use `input`.
The input needs addons other than the dial code → use `input-group` and compose it yourself.
related: `field` — wraps the control with its label, description and error.
`input-group` — the container this control renders around the dial-code select and the input.
`select` — the dial-code picker inside the group.
bestPractices: Put it in a `Field` with a `Field.Label`; the label targets the tel input.
`v-model` holds the national digits only; read `number` from the `phone-change` payload when you need the E.164 value.
Use `complete` from `phone-change` to decide `invalid` and the `Field.Error` on submit; the control shows no incomplete-number message of its own.
The field starts on the United States. Set `default-country` to start on another country (an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code from `countries`), or bind `v-model:country` when the form owns the country.
`searchPlaceholder` and `noMatch` default to English; pass translated copy in localized UIs.

props.name: countries
props.doc: Countries offered by the dial-code Select. When omitted, uses the built-in list of every region, in alphabetical order.

props.name: defaultCountry
props.doc: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country selected at first, while `v-model:country` is empty. A code missing from `countries` falls back to US, then to the first country of the list.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Placeholder of the tel input; empty shows none (never the national mask, per the example-data rule).

props.name: size
props.doc: Size forwarded to the InputGroup and the dial-code Select trigger. Heights: small=28px, medium=32px, large=40px.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables both the dial-code Select and the internal input.

props.name: readonly
props.doc: Marks the internal input read-only; dial-code Select is also disabled while readonly.

props.name: required
props.doc: Sets required and aria-required on the phone number input; it draws no border of its own.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Applies the invalid border on the InputGroup and sets aria-invalid on the input.

props.name: name
props.doc: Form field name. Set, a hidden input submits the full E.164 number (dial code followed by the digits, empty while there are none) under this name; the visible input carries no name, so a native `form` never posts a national number without its country.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.doc: Placeholder of the search box that filters the dial-code list. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Search country`).

props.name: noMatch
props.doc: Shown in the dial-code list, and announced, when no country matches the search. Empty uses the locale catalog (`No country found.`).

events.name: phone-change
events.notes: One-way snapshot of the number, emitted once on mount and again whenever the digits or the country change. `PhoneInputValue` (exported from the component) is `{ country: string; dialCode: string; digits: string; number: string; complete: boolean }`: `number` is the full E.164 number (`dialCode + digits`, e.g. `'+14155550100'`; `''` while empty) and `complete` is true when the digit count is one the selected country allows. Not a v-model — the field never reads it back.
